pull_request_body: This change adds a shared helper in argo/credentials.py that wraps Argo CD API calls. On HTTP 401, it mints a new token with the stored admin password, stores it, and retries the request once. When no password is stored, or the retry also fails, it raises ArgoError with a message naming argocd.token. Other HTTP errors raise ArgoError with the status code. The commands cd_apps_list, cd_apps_sync, and cd_apps_status use this helper instead of raw raise_for_status, so every Argo CD API error is a DevOpsCLIError that the exit seam reports as one line.
why: #2576: When Argo CD rejects the stored token with HTTP 401, every Argo CD API command ends in a Python traceback. The httpx2.HTTPStatusError is not a DevOpsCLIError, so the exit seam does not report it. The token path never replaces a stored token that the server refuses. The user must delete the keyring entry by hand.
what_changes: Add argocd_api_request helper in src/devops_cli/argo/credentials.py that handles 401 retry with token minting and raises ArgoError on failure
Update cd_apps_sync in src/devops_cli/commands/argo.py to use the helper instead of raw raise_for_status
Update cd_apps_list and cd_apps_status in src/devops_cli/commands/argo.py to use the helper instead of raw raise_for_status
feasibility: The premise is confirmed: src/devops_cli/commands/argo.py cd_apps_sync calls resp.raise_for_status() which raises httpx2.HTTPStatusError, not a DevOpsCLIError, so the exit seam of new_typer() does not report it.

src/devops_cli/argo/credentials.py resolve_argocd_server_and_token takes the stored argocd.token first. src/devops_cli/k8s/credentials.py get_or_mint_argocd_token mints only when no token is stored, so a rejected stored token is never replaced.
mint_argocd_token in src/devops_cli/k8s/credentials.py already calls POST /api/v1/session and stores the token. ArgoError in src/devops_cli/exceptions/argo.py is a DevOpsCLIError subclass.

First checks: uv run devops ci test tests/test_argo_credentials.py verifies the helper handles 401 retry, 401 without password, retry 401, and other HTTP errors. uv run devops ci test tests/test_argo_commands.py verifies the commands use the helper and raise ArgoError.
existing_tool: mint_argocd_token in src/devops_cli/k8s/credentials.py already calls the Argo CD session API (POST /api/v1/session) and stores the token. The fix reuses this function. ArgoError in src/devops_cli/exceptions/argo.py already exists as a DevOpsCLIError subclass. Nothing new is built.

decisions.decision: Shared helper in argo/credentials.py for the 401 retry logic
decisions.reason: One place for the retry logic, beside the existing token functions. Avoids duplicating the mint-and-retry across four or more commands.

decisions.decision: Raise ArgoError for all Argo CD API HTTP errors
decisions.reason: ArgoError is a DevOpsCLIError subclass, so the exit seam of new_typer() reports it as one error line with no traceback.

decisions.decision: Error message names argocd.token and the credential sync command
decisions.reason: Tells the user exactly which keyring entry to fix and which command to run.
Already holds Argo CD credential and token resolution logic. The helper belongs with the code it calls.

rejected.evidence: Duplicates the mint-and-retry logic in every command that calls the Argo CD API.
Adds an extra HTTP call to every command. The issue specifies a reactive retry on 401, not a proactive check.
Bypasses the exit seam. The user sees no structured error message.

rejected.alternative: A new exception class for Argo CD API errors
rejected.evidence: ArgoError already exists in src/devops_cli/exceptions/argo.py and is a DevOpsCLIError subclass.
Does not tell the user how to fix the problem.
Mixes command logic with credential logic. The commands should call the helper, not define it.

rejected.alternative: A new module for the helper
rejected.evidence: Unnecessary for one function. Adds a file with no other content.

added.name: Retry on 401 with stored password
added.text: When the Argo CD API returns HTTP 401 and an admin password is stored, the command SHALL mint a new token, store it in the keyring, and retry the request once.

scenarios.name: 401 with password stored
scenarios.when: the Argo CD API returns HTTP 401 and argocd.password is stored in the keyring
scenarios.then: the command mints a new token via POST /api/v1/session, stores it as argocd_token, and sends the original request again

added.name: Error on 401 without password
added.text: When the Argo CD API returns HTTP 401 and no admin password is stored, the command SHALL stop with one error line that names argocd.token and the credential sync command.

scenarios.name: 401 without password
scenarios.when: the Argo CD API returns HTTP 401 and argocd.password is not stored
scenarios.then: the command exits with one error line naming argocd.token and the credential sync command, with no traceback

added.name: Error on retry 401
added.text: When the retried request after minting a new token also returns HTTP 401, the command SHALL stop with one error line.

scenarios.name: retry also returns 401
scenarios.when: the command mints a new token and retries, and the Argo CD API returns HTTP 401 again
scenarios.then: the command exits with one error line, with no traceback

added.name: Error on other HTTP status
added.text: When the Argo CD API returns any HTTP status other than 401, the command SHALL stop with one error line containing the status code.

scenarios.name: HTTP 500 response
scenarios.when: the Argo CD API returns HTTP 500
scenarios.then: the command exits with one error line containing the text '500', with no traceback

added.name: Argo CD API errors are DevOpsCLIError
added.text: Every Argo CD API error SHALL be raised as a DevOpsCLIError subclass so the exit seam reports it.

scenarios.name: error type check
scenarios.when: the Argo CD API returns an error status
scenarios.then: the raised exception is an instance of DevOpsCLIError

groups.title: Add argocd_api_request helper
groups.test: Write a test that mocks the HTTP client to return 401, then verifies argocd_api_request mints a new token via mint_argocd_token, stores it, and retries the request. Write a test for 401 without password that verifies ArgoError is raised with a message naming argocd.token. Write a test for retry 401 that verifies ArgoError is raised. Write a test for HTTP 500 that verifies ArgoError is raised with the status code in the message
groups.implementation: Add argocd_api_request to src/devops_cli/argo/credentials.py. It takes the client, method, url, headers, json body, timeout, and settings. It makes the request. On 401 with a stored password, it calls mint_argocd_token, updates the Authorization header, and retries once. On 401 without a password, it raises ArgoError naming argocd.token and devops k8s credentials sync. On retry 401, it raises ArgoError. On any other non-2xx status, it raises ArgoError with the status code. On success, it returns the response
groups.verify: uv run devops ci test tests/test_argo_credentials.py
